rights.basis: Bibliographic facts and original scope note only. Full-text operations, raw retention, embeddings and figure reuse are unassessed and not performed.

records.metadataLocator: Publication heading, DOI and citation/issue metadata in indexed source; not linked recommendations or references.
records.metadataNote: Cited issue/publication year retained; DOI year is not used as a date inference. Metadata only; see source for complete authorship.
